header.title: Executive Financial Dashboard
header.description: Real-time operating cash intelligence, automated cash-burn tracking, and risk alerts for small and medium enterprises.
header.exportSuccess: Export completed: Ledger CSV downloaded successfully.
header.resetSuccess: Dashboard refreshed: Ledger synchronized with MongoDB.

metrics.currentCashTooltip: Operating liquidity currently in bank accounts based on verified paid transactions plus configured opening balance.
metrics.netCashFlowTooltip: Difference between total paid income and paid expenses across the recorded operational history.
metrics.pendingReceivablesTooltip: Invoiced customer payments awaiting collection. Uncollected funds are not counted in current cash balance.
metrics.pendingPayablesTooltip: Scheduled supplier bills and obligations pending payment settlement.
metrics.runwayTooltip: Calculated operational survival runway based on average net burn rate and current cash balance.

charts.overviewDesc: Monthly breakdown comparing paid customer inflows, operational expenses, and resulting net cash movements.
charts.forecastDesc: Deterministic forward projection incorporating conservative collection timing and verified run-rate.
charts.noChartData: Insufficient historical transactions to render chart.

alerts.sectionDesc: Automated anomaly and cash shortfall detection triggered by backend risk analysis algorithms.
alerts.noAlertsTitle: Healthy Cash Flow — No Critical Warnings
alerts.noAlertsDesc: Your operating cash velocity and reserves currently meet baseline stability thresholds.
